data.description:
## Context / Problem
Observed live (watchdog, 2026-08-14 08:46 PT): fsck ORPHAN_EVENT on e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2 — `1786722148...-48c15795-...-COMMENT.json` is unretired, timestamped BEFORE the current snapshot (1786722245...), and absent from its `source_event_uuids`. Confirmed mechanism (a distributed fold-horizon race, NOT a crash): bridge-bot committed the COMMENT on its own clone at 08:42:28 and pushed at 08:45:34; a local session ran COMPACT at 08:44:05, enumerating fold inputs before the bridge push merged; the union merge then landed the comment file into a dir whose snapshot postdates it. Result: no file loss, but the reducer's replay (snapshot + post-snapshot events) skips the comment — it is INVISIBLE in `rebar show` (verified: 16 comments rendered, orphan absent) while existing on disk and in Jira. The crash-atomic fold (compulsory-pernickety-mantis, merged) is orthogonal: journaling/rollback protects against interrupted folds, not against concurrent remote arrivals; `compact` also refuses a manual re-fold here ("remote SNAPSHOT exists" guard), so today there is NO supported repair door for this class.

## Proposed fix
Two-sided, portable (no CI dependency):
1) **Self-heal at read/fold time**: teach the fold (and/or reducer) that an unretired event older than the active snapshot but missing from `source_event_uuids` is a LATE ARRIVAL, not noise — fold it into the next snapshot (re-fold absorbing orphans) or replay it after the snapshot despite its timestamp (stable order: snapshot, then orphans by ts, then post-snapshot events). Choose ONE semantics and pin it with tests; re-fold is preferred because it also clears the fsck finding.
2) **Repair door**: `rebar doctor --repair` handles ORPHAN_EVENT by triggering that absorbing re-fold under the store write lock (compact's "remote SNAPSHOT exists" refusal must not block the doctor path; doctor passes an explicit absorb flag). Backup ref before mutation, mirroring the dirty-tracker repair envelope (change 1771).

## Scope
- Fold/enumeration seam in src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py (+ compact.py guard) — absorb-orphans path.
- Reducer replay seam if option (replay) chosen instead.
- src/rebar/_commands/doctor.py — ORPHAN_EVENT repair routing.
- Tests: fold-race reproduction (event file lands post-enumeration pre-commit via union merge), absorbing re-fold clears fsck and restores comment visibility in show; guard test that a genuinely retired-and-folded event is NOT re-absorbed.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A reproduced fold-race orphan is visible in `rebar show` after the repair, and fsck reports 0 ORPHAN_EVENT for the ticket; new integration test.
- [ ] `rebar doctor --repair` clears ORPHAN_EVENT via absorbing re-fold with a backup ref; unit test.
- [ ] A retired event already in `source_event_uuids` is never re-absorbed; guard test.
- [ ] `make lint`/`make typecheck` clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before close.

## Out of scope
Bridge/Jira duplicate-comment reconciliation policy; crash-atomicity (landed with mantis); dirty-tree repair (landed with dormouse 1771).
data.title: Fold-horizon race: concurrent remote write during compact leaves ORPHAN_EVENT invisible to replay; no repair door
